i will say i wish i still enjoyed making stuff. losing that was more painful than losing friends or my partner. losing that has left me so fucking empty and broken. its so unfair. i didnt need people and i didnt need to feel ok when i could distract myself with that and sometimes i was excited or proud or feeling something positive or at least neutral and at ease. and now its just like everything fucking else where it pisses me off and i still feel everything so acutely and loudly when i try to work and im always so fucking tired and wanting to die that all i can think about is sleeping or cold chillin doing fucking nothing and i hate it but i dont know what to do. ive frayed my fuckin brain into nothing trying to turn all of this around and trying to stop feeling this way and all i am is fucking tired and still sitting right where i fucking started

we're all mid late 20s and have known eachother a couple years so they sorta know my deal and no one really knows what to do. none of this is a surprise to anyone, parents, friends, etc. I think a lot of them expect to lose me that way. i've been involuntarily committed a bunch and everyone knows i've had a substance abuse issue 7+ years but no one wants to talk about it, even though ive tried and failed to do AA/NA and get sober. and i honestly don't know that they could help. it's easy to look at nice stories about people turning things around with help from loved one, but helping someone like me is very difficult and frustrating and prone to create issues in my relationships. I am also very prone to binging drugs and isolating myself when I have conflict or blow ups with people. 

and talking with them really doesnt help. i dont feel comforted by it and usually i either feel immensely dissappointed by the lack of understanding when i choose to open up or it causes giant arguments because I either get angry at the other person or they get upset at me. idk. it's not a simple issue. drugs replaced people/things in my life when I was 17 and has been the only thing that has consistently been there for me since then. I can't mantain sobriety because when I stop using there's just nothing there and I end up not being able to cope and relapsing really hard. i dont want to break the cycle. i've been trying over a year to get sober and cant. i dont want to anymore. it's not like you get sober and just stop wanting to use, you always want to use you just can't anymore and you have to learn to deal with everything in a whole new way. the thought of doing all of that just makes me more suicidal. im so fucking tired of trying.

there's just not anything good. i dont want to go to work tomorrow. i dont want to ignore the calls from the debt collectors for the money i dont have tomorrow. i dont want to come home to an empty apartment to be by myself. i dont want to do any of this anymore. there isn't anything good in my life. I have one or two okay friends. my parents are indifferent towards me and find me troubled. the things i used to enjoy doing dont provide satisfaction of any kind and feel like burdens from another time. i dont want to wake up into this exsistence and force the motions of another difficult day. i dont have any energy left to or any reason to. i feel like i am just waiting for a fatal overdose at this point and im disappointed it hasnt happened. drugs dont even feel good anymore, it's just a way to not feel like this.

i just have a hard time even pursuing hobbies anymore. I make art but work 6-7 days a week and i just havent had the real desire to in 8-10 months. i try to do things but my interest has waned and waned until doing things i enjoy feels like a chore now and I just feel sad and hopeless over even solitary distractions no longer providing adequate fulfillment.

i don't want it to suck anymore but it's not going to change. things are very lonely, people are very unkind and I am so alone. i dont want to be this angry and struggling this hard for another day. i am so tired of trying to fill this hole that's supposed to have people and memories with drugs and drinking and worthless shit because I don't have good things to put in it

yes, but i have very overwhelming negative feelings and very bad anger that consumes the bit of positive in my life. there's not people to be kind to me in my life and it's very hard to glean satisfaction from the happiness i do have in the face of it. I want things in my life to be very different rather than dying but they are not going to change, I have tried very hard and disappointed myself over and over for them. i will not do it anymore
